== Creature statistics ==

The Legacy title audit found Thrawn’s Pet / Thrawn’s Ysalamir had Ferocity 3 and Fangs 4, while the article used Power 3. Optional ferocity and fangs fields now render those printed creature statistics. Empty fields produce no rows; other card types retain their existing layout.
